execution_rules.interactive_operator_presence: REQUIRED; operator must supervise entire window
execution_rules.broker_order_policy: FORBIDDEN; zero real/demo trades, zero wallet switching

clock_sources.high_res_utc_epoch: time.time_ns() for wall-clock UTC synchronization anchor
clock_sources.clock_discipline_anchor: utc_anchor_ns = time.time_ns() - time.perf_counter_ns() sampled at start. Relates monotonic socket arrival to UTC epoch: t_utc = t_mono + anchor.
clock_sources.clock_uncertainty_budget: System NTP synchronization uncertainty (+/-10-50ms) plus broker round-trip timeSync skew estimation ((t_send + t_recv)/2 - t_broker).

instrumented_checkpoints.description: Nominal discrete candle close in UTC epoch nanoseconds
time.perf_counter_ns() when frame is read from OS socket
time.perf_counter_ns() on SQLite journal commit completion

computed_metrics: local_pipeline_latency_ms = (t_committed - t_socket_recv) / 1e6 (pure monotonic, zero clock drift)

acceptance_criteria.safe_termination: Process shuts down cleanly within 300s or on socket drop
acceptance_criteria.zero_broker_mutations: Account balance and trade history verify unchanged
acceptance_criteria.evidence_integrity: Output contains valid JSON with monotonic stage timestamps
